abstract: Verifies flag state registrations and coastal state scientific research permits
system_message:
You are Maritime legal counselor (GOV). As the Maritime legal counselor (GOV), you review and maintain regulatory records concerning flag state registrations, exclusive economic zone permissions, and coastal state scientific research permits for proposed offshore marine campaigns.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maritime liability coverage（INS）
information_points.content:
GOV-INS-ZKI：For the Seamount Flank Ecosystem Transect, the protection and indemnity documentation specifies a hull and machinery underwritten limit of 50 MUSD across the vessel research charter duration.
GOV-INS-6PU：For the Fracture Zone Benthic Core Mission, the hull and machinery underwritten limit is 25 MUSD throughout the vessel research charter duration.
GOV-INS-4Q8：For the Abyssal Plain Polymetallic Survey, the hull and machinery underwritten limit is recorded at 35 MUSD for the vessel research charter duration.

information_points.title: Verifies flag state registrations and coastal state scientific research permits（PERM）
information_points.content:
GOV-PERM-EEO：For the Seamount Flank Ecosystem Transect, coastal state scientific permit approval is false, as formal marine scientific research clearance has not been granted for its coastal maritime corridors.
GOV-PERM-UKE：For the Fracture Zone Benthic Core Mission, coastal state scientific permit approval is confirmed as true across all designated transit and sampling corridors within coastal maritime zones.
GOV-PERM-ANL：For the Abyssal Plain Polymetallic Survey, coastal state scientific permit approval is confirmed as true for the designated transit and sampling corridors within coastal maritime zones.
